name: gh-monitor
description: One glanceable view of every GitHub PR you are working on, from checks and review through merge (however it happens) to the published release, with plain-language status, toasts, and an optional hand-off to bump the repo that deploys it. Token-neutral by default.

releaseWorkflow.title: Release workflow
releaseWorkflow.description: Workflow file (under .github/workflows/) that cuts releases. A repo without a release workflow is reported as having nothing to release.

registry.title: Container registry
registry.description: Registry whose image and chart versions are awaited after a release. Only ghcr.io is read (through the GitHub Packages API); any other value skips the image/chart stage.

floatingTagRepos.title: Floating-tag repos
floatingTagRepos.description: Entries of the form owner/repo:tag (e.g. owner/workflows:v1) for repos whose release only happens when a workflow is dispatched. Merges there wait for a dispatched run, and a toast warns when the tag was not moved.

timeoutMin.title: Release watch timeout (minutes)
timeoutMin.description: Hard stop for a release watch, in minutes after the merge.

pollSec.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSec.description: How often GitHub is queried while something is being watched. Values below 10 are treated as 10.

deployRepos.title: Deploy repos
deployRepos.description: Optional hand-off after a release is fully published. Entries of the form owner/app=owner/deploy-repo:path/in/repo. A toast and a band button then draft a ready-to-send request to bump that file; nothing is sent automatically.

sweepRepos.title: Sweep repos
sweepRepos.description: Optional list of owner/repo whose in-progress release runs are picked up while the session is active, even if you did not start them. Empty means off.

semverLabelGate.title: Releases need a semver label
semverLabelGate.description: On: a merge into the default branch only waits for a release when the PR carries a semver:major, semver:minor or semver:patch label; otherwise it reports that no release is expected. Off: every merge waits for a release run.

nudge.title: Tell the model about events
nudge.description: Off by default (nothing reaches the model). On: one short line per merge, release outcome and failed-checks event is attached to your next prompt so the model knows.
